name: Gamen kara Detekita Oshi Vtuber to H na Dousei Seikatsu ~Shomin-ha Kyuuketsuki Ojou-sama wa Keiyaku Shitai~
original_name: 画面から出てきた推しVtuberとHな同棲生活 ～庶民派吸血鬼お嬢様は契約したい～
source:
Masato Kasakabe has a miserable job that's constantly overworking him.
His sole pleasure is supporting his favorite vtubers.

"Ahh, if only my oshi jumped through the screen right now..."

Masato starts fantasizing about living with his oshi.
But that could never happen for real...

Until suddenly, he ends up with three of his favorites as his roommates.
With vtubers now existing in the flesh, a dimension-spanning love story begins now...

[b]A contract with the (surprisingly frugal) vampire noblewoman[/b]

To help with finances while Masato looks for a new job, Ruby gets a part-time job.
Despite the struggles, the two of them do their best to support each other at work.

But then Ruby notices a new feeling budding inside her, something she's never felt before...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2699600/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
笠部正人的工作很糟糕，经常让他超负荷工作。
他唯一的乐趣就是支持他最喜欢的vtuber。

“啊啊，要是我的大神现在就跳出画面就好了……”

正人开始幻想与他的oshi一起生活。
但这永远不可能真正发生……

直到突然之间，他终于和三个他最喜欢的人成为了室友。
随着vtuber们现身，一场跨次元的爱情故事即将开始……

[b]与（出奇节俭的）吸血鬼贵妇签订的契约[/b]

为了在正人寻找新工作期间帮助解决财务问题，鲁比找到了一份兼职工作。
尽管困难重重，两人在工作中仍尽力互相支持。

但随后鲁比注意到一种新的感觉在她体内萌芽，这是她以前从未感受过的……
